verdict.rationale: Ollama is an open-source local model runtime, so building it from source is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents build-from-source instructions, toolchain requirements or dependency footprint. The GitHub items only cover integrations, model usage and the REST API, and the install evidence is a prebuilt install script.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build the runtime from source with minimal external dependencies
